transcription_notes: Source: GG-00106, 3-column Ge'ez book hand with red rubrication for divisions; generally clean and legible at high magnification (transcribed by cropping each column and upscaling ~3.2x-9x, since the source JPEGs are only ~1650x1700 px and individual fidel are sub-readable at native render scale). 1 KINGS 1 SPANS f028v (all 3 columns) and f029r (left column + first ~30 lines of the middle column). It does NOT extend onto f029v/f030r (those are 1 Kings 2+). CH.1 START: on f028v, LEFT column. The black text at the very top of the left column is the tail of 2 Samuel 24 (peace/burnt offerings, the LORD entreated for the land, plague stayed -- NOT transcribed). Then a red rule, then a one-line RED book-incipit/colophon-heading 'ለዳግማዊ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ ጸሐፍዎ ፡ ናታን ፡ ወጌድ' ('For the Second [book of] Kings/Reigns; Nathan and Gad wrote it' -- a heading, NOT scripture, excluded from verses), then a red rule. 1 Kings 1:1 begins IMMEDIATELY AFTER that red book-incipit, written itself in red rubrication for its first ~2 lines ('ወዳዊትሰ ንጉሥ ልህቀ ...'), continuing in black; this is ~line 7 of the left column. CH.1 END / CH.2 START: 1 Kings 1 runs through v53 (Solomon brings Adonijah down from the altar, bows, 'go to thy house'). Ch.2 begins in the MIDDLE column of f029r, ~line 31-33: the clause 'ወሶበ ፡ ቦ ፡ ጸሐ ፡ ማዋዕሊሁ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ለመዊት ፡ እዘዘ ፡ ለሰሎሞን' (2:1, 'And when the days of David drew near that he should die, he charged Solomon') followed by a RED '✣'-type division marker, then 2:2 'ወይቤሎ ፡ አንሰ ፡ ሐርኩ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ምድር ...' (David's deathbed charge: be strong, keep the charge of the LORD, walk in his ways, keep his statutes as written in the law of Moses). I STOPPED at v53; 2:1 onward NOT transcribed. The very end of v53 / start of 2:1 sits in a faded, partly-rubricated zone on f029r mid-col (~line 30) -- v53's final 2-3 words ('go to thy house') are abraded; transcribed best-effort and flagged 'damaged' rather than guessed. DIVISION MARKERS: the manuscript carries red '✣'-type fine division ornaments and a small '〉⟐〈' line-fill ornament (seen in v2 on f028v left col after 'ለእግዚእን ንጉሥ'); these are NOT scripture and were stripped from geez/tokens (the line-fill ornament noted here; the chapter-boundary red ✣ noted above). No coarse 'ምዕራፍ'-spelled rubric was visible within this span; the ch.1/ch.2 boundary is anchored on the NARRATIVE + the red ✣ before 'ወይቤሎ አንሰ ሐርኩ'. The manuscript uses '፡' as the word divider and '።'/'፣' for major stops and carries NO modern verse numerals; verse segmentation follows the standard 1 Kings 1 narrative structure (53 verses) mapped onto the visible Ge'ez clauses, so verse boundaries are editorial (sense-unit) judgements, not manuscript-marked. ORTHOGRAPHY/UNCERTAINTY: this hand frequently writes proper names with ambiguous vowel order at this resolution -- flagged as 'uncertain' are: Abishag's town (Sanamit/Sunamawit, v3); Haggith/Egit (v5,v11); Zeruiah/Sorhya (v7); Jehoiada/Yodahe (v8); Shimei/Semi & Rei/Rasi (v8); stone of Zoheleth ze-Eltez (v9); En-rogel/Rogel (v9); Bathsheba/Bersabeh (v11+); Gihon/Gihwon (v33); Cherethites/Keret & Pelethites/Felet (v38,v44). Other genuine reading doubts flagged: v1 'ወኢይነመውቆ' (word straddles the red->black line break at the rubricated incipit, 'and he gat no heat'); v2 'ወትቅም'/'ህየ'/'ውዱ' (mid-clause faded glyphs in the 'seek a virgin to stand before the king' clause); v4 'ትሰልኮ'/'ወአዘንተ'; v15 the ministering-subject (should be Abishag) faded; v40/v45 the 'rejoiced'/'city rang' verb clusters; v52 'ሰዕሌሁ'. Where I genuinely could read a best form I transcribed it and flagged it; I did NOT substitute any standard/printed Ge'ez or any other source -- no '⟦illegible⟧' sentinel was needed because every faded span was still best-readable (the worst, v53's tail, is flagged 'damaged'). Verse count: 53, contiguous v1..v53.
